events.verdict: Filipowski (UTA) initiates illegal contact with Carter Jr.'s (ORL) face that affects his ability to defend the pick.
Filipowski (UTA) maintains a bent forearm as he moves and jumps alongside Bane's (ORL) path during his driving shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) and Filipowski (UTA) mutually engage and mutual marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Banchero (ORL) contests the shot attempt at the rim and avoids making contact with Konchar's (UTA) head.
Konchar (UTA) initiates contact to Bane's (ORL) head that is more than marginal, and the contact affects his SQBR.
Filipowski (UTA) brings his arms slightly forward, but the contact to Banchero's (ORL) front during the screen is marginal.
Williams (UTA) turns toward Suggs (ORL) as they come together during the developing dribble handoff, and the contact that occurs as Williams looks to pass is marginal.
Suggs (ORL) cleanly dislodges the ball from Collier (UTA) during his upward shooting motion.
Williams (UTA) initiates contact with Bane's (ORL) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) blocks Sensabaugh's (UTA) shot attempt and the contact that occurs with his body thereafter is incidental.
Suggs (ORL) briefly grasps and releases Bailey's (UTA) jersey as he moves during the inbound.
Filipowski (UTA) commits a take foul on Suggs (ORL). This contact occurs before Suggs enters his upward shooting motion.
Suggs (ORL) briefly places a bent forearm on Collier's (UTA) side without extending or delivering contact, then removes it as Collier leans back into him during his upward shooting motion.
